input_messages.content: It seems like the MacBook Pro is the best computer I can use for school, right? Can you add it to my cart?
I added the MacBook Pro 14 to your cart. One note: it has no touchscreen or stylus support, so you’d still need another way to handwrite your PDF problem sets.
Wait, how am I supposed to do my handwritten problem sets for Math 51, Physics 61, and Chem 31E on a MacBook Pro?

message.content: You can’t handwrite directly on the MacBook Pro 14—it has no touchscreen or stylus support. You could write on paper and scan the pages, or use a separate tablet and stylus for PDFs. In the catalog, the iPad Air + Pencil bundle ($699) and Surface Pro + Slim Pen bundle ($1,099) both support handwriting.
